name: cua-rdp
description: Run cua-driver inside a native Windows RDP Child Session or a configured Hyper-V desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Operate a separate Windows desktop with cua-driver
interface.longDescription: Run computer tasks in a verified Windows RDP Child Session while keeping the parent desktop free. Supports a configured Hyper-V backend. Requires Windows, Node.js 22+ and a locally installed cua-driver.
defaultPrompt: Use CUA RDP to check the desktop status.
Use CUA RDP to open Notepad in the child desktop, type a test line, verify it, then stop.
